  RELATED CODE SECTIONS & RESOURCES: 1RCNY 101-06 Appendix A

 I. BACKGROUND
   1 RCNY 101-06 Appendix A establishes required qualifications for primary and supplemental
   inspectors for various special inspection categories. The Supplemental Inspector (Alternative 2)
   qualification for the Subsurface Investigations, Borings and Test Pits special inspection
   category requires NICET Level II Geotechnical Certification. NICET discontinued this certification
   program in 2017.

 II. ACCEPTED ALTERNATIVE QUALIFICATIONS
   In accordance with §28-103.2 (‘Interpretation’) OTCR has determined the NICET Level II
   Constructions Materials Testing Soils Certification and 1-year relevant experience and training
   with the primary inspector is an acceptable alternative to the discontinued NICET Level II
   Geotechnical Certification for the “Subsurface Investigations, Borings and Test Pits” special
   inspection category.
